plans.acceptanceCriteria: F-000-2 closed per the C3 delta: quickMemoNotebookIds joins notebooks and filters owner_user_id = writeOwnerUserId() AND library_id = writeLibraryId(), the same identity the creation insert binds (both predicates required — owner-only scoping would resurrect cross-library leakage); the multi-holder invariant is evaluated within that scope only. testASecondAccountCannotCaptureIntoAnotherAccountsQuickMemosNotebook is replaced by per-principal assertions: distinct notebooks per account, each containing only its own captures, no cross-visibility and no error. captureQuickMemo(bodyMarkdown:title:) still routes through createNote so auto-actions enqueue and a change event publishes; the once-only notebookCreated publish (C4 delta, F-000-6) stays as implemented and test-pinned. Concurrency/idempotency and per-scope duplicate-kind-tag failure tests pass.

F-000-5 closed: the co-occurrence limit is threaded through NoteService.tagDetail(tagId:coOccurringTagLimit:) as a defaulted parameter so NoteGraphQLService+TagEntity computes the aggregate once on a non-default limit instead of discarding and re-running it; every existing caller compiles against the default (build gate catches drift). F-000-4 recorded: the E6 root-field argument shape tagDetail(tagId: String!, coOccurringTagLimit: Int) is unchanged and a nested-argument selection stays rejected and pinned by test. promoteTagNote / unpromoteTagNote keep returning NoteMutationPayload with the operation allow-lists and GraphQLNoteSchemaContract doc string in agreement; the enforced GraphQL schema inventory is green.

F-000-8 closed: when the positional argument of kaiba tag parses as a NoteID and resolves to no tag, the error restores the pre-ba7ef12 hint (tag requires --add <name> or --remove <name>) instead of the bare tag not found: note-…; covered by a new command test. The rest of the E7 surface (tag promote --tag --note, tag unpromote --tag, enriched kaiba tag <name-or-id>) is KEEP material and stays behaviourally unchanged. Sources/AppCore/Command.swift is edited for usage text only and by this plan only.

F-000-1 and F-000-3 closed per the C6 delta: the 404 arm, the noteCaptureNotebookUnavailableMessage constant and testASecondAccountAnswersAGeneric404ThatNamesNoForeignNotebook are deleted as unreachable under the C3 delta; the blanket catch NoteServiceError.invalidInput -> 400 mapping is removed so any service error on a route-validated request (including the singleton-invariant violation) answers the existing generic 500. The route's 400 must still be produced by the route's own body validation — tests pin both directions: blank/malformed body -> 400, invariant failure -> 500, second-account capture -> 201 into that account's own notebook. The route doc comment states the amended 201/400/401/405/503/500 contract; GET /note/capture still serves the SPA bootstrap via the /note/register rewrite pattern; authenticated and --allow-unauthenticated modes both covered.

New view web/src/views/CaptureView.tsx — the name NoteCapture.tsx is taken by an unrelated pre-existing inline composer and the canonical map in web/src/notes/controller.ts is a notebook cache; neither may be repurposed or collided with. Routing is hash-based while the C5 rewrite serves the app at path /note/capture with no hash, so App boot detects location.pathname === '/note/capture' and renders the capture view without disturbing existing hash routes (router tests guard). The view renders textarea plus submit and posts to POST /note/capture with the per-origin bearer credential stored by NoteGraphQLClient — registration reuses the existing ?code= initialize flow, no parallel mechanism; success shows the note id and clears the field; error bodies from the amended C6 contract render; a visitor with no stored credential gets the existing unregistered/registration surface. Vitest covers submit success, error body rendering and the unregistered path. Land this plan before TASK-008 (shared appStore.tsx).
